description: This file defines the LeaveRequestCommentDao class, which manages database operations related to leave request comments in the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for searching, counting, and saving comments, as well as some deprecated methods for fetching leave requests and leaves by ID.

classes.name: LeaveRequestCommentDao
classes.description: DAO class for handling leave request comment database operations, including search, save, and count functionalities.

methods.description: Returns the count of leave request comments matching the search filter.

methods.description: Constructs and returns a paginator object for paginating leave request comment search results.

methods.description: Persists a LeaveRequestComment entity into the database.
